parameters.query:
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS customer_id, w.id AS watch_id, w.created_at
    FROM customers c
    JOIN customer_interests ci ON ci.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN watches w
      ON lower(w.brand) = lower(ci.brand)
     AND (ci.reference IS NULL OR lower(ci.reference) = lower(w.reference))
     AND (ci.max_budget_usd IS NULL OR w.ask_usd <= ci.max_budget_usd * 1.1)
    WHERE c.marketing_opt_in
      AND w.status = 'in_stock'
      AND w.listings_done
      AND w.auth_status IN ('ai_checked', 'watchmaker_verified')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_log m WHERE m.customer_id = c.id AND m.watch_id = w.id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_log m
                      WHERE m.customer_id = c.id
                        AND m.campaign IN ('interest_campaign', 'reengagement')
                        AND m.created_at > now() - setting_num('campaign_cooldown_days') * INTERVAL '1 day')
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS n
    FROM matches
)
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.language,
       json_agg(json_build_object(
           'watch_id', w.id, 'brand', w.brand, 'model', w.model, 'reference', w.reference,
           'year', w.year, 'condition', w.condition, 'box_papers', w.box_papers,
           'price_usd', w.ask_usd,
           'listing_title', COALESCE(l.title, en.title))) AS watches,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM top5 t
JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id
JOIN watches w   ON w.id = t.watch_id
LEFT JOIN listings l  ON l.watch_id = w.id AND l.language = c.language
LEFT JOIN listings en ON en.watch_id = w.id AND en.language = 'en'
WHERE t.n <= 5
GROUP BY c.id;

parameters.content:
## Weekly campaign by interest
Every Monday, each opted-in customer gets one personal email (in their language) with up to 5 in-stock watches that match their interests and that they have not been sent before. Nobody gets more than one campaign per `campaign_cooldown_days`.
